questions.q: What did Tingi and his grandmother do after the soldiers took the cows?
questions.explain: They hid to avoid the soldiers.

questions.q: What did Tingi’s grandmother do to protect him from the soldier who stepped on him?
questions.explain: She hid him under the leaves to protect him from the soldier.

questions.q: What did Tingi and his grandmother do after the soldiers left?
questions.explain: They came out of hiding very quietly.

questions.q: How did Tingi's grandmother help him when the soldiers returned?
questions.explain: Tingi's grandmother hid him under the leaves to protect him from the soldiers.

questions.q: What happened when the soldiers came back?
questions.explain: One of the soldiers put his foot on Tingi, but he kept quiet.
